Blast chiller maintenance and servicing

Regular blast chiller maintenance means fewer breakdowns, controlled energy use and equipment that lasts. FrigAirco provides one-off blast chiller servicing and maintenance contracts, for businesses and homeowners.

Call 0487 87 09 93Request a quote
  • blast freezer
  • rapid chiller
  • blast chiller-freezer

What blast chiller maintenance includes

A blast chiller takes your dishes from cooking temperature to chilled in a very short time, as food hygiene rules require. When it stops, the whole kitchen comes to a halt.

  • Cleaning the condenser and the evaporator
  • Checking the core probe and the air probes
  • Checking door seals and the defrost
  • Checking pull-down times
  • Leak check of the refrigeration circuit

Blast chiller maintenance contract

With a maintenance contract for your blast chiller, visits are scheduled in advance and the checks are recorded each time. We agree the frequency with you, depending on the equipment and how it is used.

Frequently asked questions

How often is blast chiller maintenance needed?

It depends on the equipment and how it is used. One visit a year is a common minimum; equipment that runs continuously, or in a greasy or dusty environment, needs more frequent visits. We agree the frequency with you.

Is blast chiller maintenance mandatory?

Above a certain quantity of refrigerant, the F-Gas regulation requires periodic leak checks carried out by a certified technician. We tell you what applies to your equipment.

Do you offer a blast chiller maintenance contract?

Yes. The blast chiller maintenance contract covers scheduled visits and follow-up of the equipment. Request a quote.
